headline_hook: GPT-5 Drops Alongside Open-Weight Models While Anthropic Hits $30B
preview_topics: GPT-5 and the open-weight double drop

pick_of_the_day.thesis: OpenAI's first public look at a 'dark factory' — 1M LOC with zero human code and zero human review — reveals that the real moat isn't the model, it's the harness infrastructure that lets you ship a billion tokens a day without a single engineer touching the output.

model_literacy.relevance: OpenAI simultaneously shipped GPT-5 (closed API) and open-weight models, while GLM-5.1 and Netflix both went open — today's news is a live case study in when companies choose open distribution versus API lock-in, and what builders gain or lose with each path.
